shared_elements: head with headgear or cap-like top
arms bent with hands brought to the front of the torso
single figure occupying the full height of the field
justification: Both depict a single upright human figure filling the field, with a distinct head covering and arms bent so the hands meet in front of the body, which is the only real correspondence. Otherwise A is a highly schematic, near-abstract three-dimensional figure with featureless face and no attributes, while B is a detailed profile figure in a pleated robe holding a long spear with a bow and quiver at the shoulder — different conventions and a different iconographic content.
